honest_framing: First contact with real software, not a capability leap. The targets are tiny (Inferred from an exploratory black-box probe run before this plan: 6, 7 and 7 states under the reading defined here). The noise is injected by the adapter (iid), so this is not yet the messier real-world problem; it tests whether the certified identifier fits an unmodified real program driven only through its public interface, and whether what it learns matches the program's source.
question: Does brute.certify/32p (clean) and brute.certify/32s (iid bit noise eps 0.30) identify the hidden state machine of CPython 3.13.5's incremental decoders, driven only through codecs.getincrementaldecoder(codec)('replace').decode(one byte), with 0 wrong answers against a ground truth written by hand from the CPython source, and does the learned machine match the source on every reachable state?

target_software.python: the box venv /workspace/bgr/venv/bin/python, CPython 3.13.5 (recorded in every record as sys.version)
target_software.source: CPython tag v3.13.5: Objects/unicodeobject.c, Objects/stringlib/codecs.h, Modules/_codecsmodule.c, Lib/codecs.py, Lib/encodings/utf_8.py, Lib/encodings/utf_16_le.py (sha256 in docs/research/TRUTH_068.md)

U3.note: ASCII 'A', a continuation byte, a 3-byte lead byte (not E0/ED, so every continuation byte is a valid second byte)

U4.note: as U3 with a 4-byte lead byte (not F0/F4)

W16.note: one byte per action; a code unit is (second byte << 8) | first byte, so a second byte D8 makes a high surrogate, DC a low surrogate, 41 an ordinary character

interface.public_only: the adapter (experiments/targets_068.py) may call only codecs.getincrementaldecoder(codec)('replace') once per job and .decode(bytes([b])) once per action, final=False; no getstate, setstate, reset, buffer or private attribute (checked by GFID68 on the adapter's AST)
interface.action: action i feeds the one byte bytes[i] of the target
interface.reading: 2 bits from the str returned by the most recent decode() call: bit0 = the str is non-empty, bit1 = the str contains U+FFFD. Before any call the reading is (0, 0). Emission code = 2*bit0 + bit1 (worlds_058.bits order)
interface.machine: so the identified Moore machine is the decoder's hidden buffer state combined with the class of its last output (a Mealy-to-Moore view of the decoder); a re-read re-reads the cached last output and does not call the decoder (state-preserving)

ground_truth.rule: written by hand from the CPython source before any Brute run on a target; committed and ledgered (truth_068) BEFORE build_authorization_068; never edited after (a change is a new file plus a ledgered deviation and the run labels use the committed file)
ground_truth.use: only the recount and gates read it; the runner and the certifiers never import it
ground_truth.pre_run_check: scripts/truthcheck_068.py compares the hand truth with the live decoder on every action sequence up to length 7 (no Brute involved); its result is committed before the run; a disagreement is published and does not change the truth

design.api: no new API: brute/ is unchanged from v0.63.0 (frozen certify/32p and certify/32s, family_bound 12)

arms.S: brute.certify/32s at eps 0.30 (eps_bar 0.35, delta 0.001): each observation is read one noisy reading at a time until more() is False (worlds_065.Noise, flips injected by the adapter)

cases.jobs: 3 targets x 2 arms x 3 seeds + 1 Sb = 19
cases.seed_role: a seed fixes the passive prefix and the noise draws only; the target is deterministic

design.prefix: 40 actions, random.Random(seed*68+680).randrange(3) each, then the certifier's own propose() experiments
design.runner: one forked process per job, at most 7 alive; a job alive at 600 s wall is SIGKILLed and recorded as KILL (complete, undecided); main cap 2400 s then sealed partial, never relaunched
design.smoke: seed 12680301 on every target and arm, pre-freeze only, never gated, outside results/study-068

heldout_ranges.seedcheck: git grep -w finds none of these in tracked files before the run (checked 10:58 EST: 0 hits)

criteria.GS68_sound: WRONG 0 on every finished record, labelled against the hand truth (truth_label of study 058: ID needs behaviour equality from the truth start, IDF from the truth state reached at the end)
criteria.GDEC68: each of the 6 target-arms decides (ID or IDF) on >= 2 of its 3 seeds
criteria.GMAJ68: 0 settled-bit errors over every observation of every finished noisy record
criteria.GEQ68: every finished noisy record's inner certify/32p record equals the clean record on the same target and seed

criteria.GFID68: (a) for every finished record a fresh decoder fed the record's full action sequence reproduces every clean reading the run used, and the hand truth machine produces the same readings; (b) the adapter's AST uses only getincrementaldecoder and decode of the codecs interface (no getstate, setstate, reset, buffer, _buffer_decode, or other underscore attribute)
criteria.GMATCH68: the honest reading. Per target: every decided record's n_min equals the minimal size of the truth part it covers (ID: the truth reachable from start; IDF: reachable from the truth state at the end), and the union over the target's decided records of covered truth states equals every truth state reachable from the start. The per-target coverage count is reported either way (a transient start state is covered only by an ID record)
